select (case when frequency_loading ='WEEKDAYS' then fulldate  when frequency_loading ='DAILY' then dateadd(dd,1,CRM_Date) END ) fulldate
from 
    eds.eds_ctl ect
inner join 
    eds.date_dim dd
    on 
    ect.CRM_Date=dd.previous_business_day
    and dd.business_day_flag='Y'
inner join
    om.om_tasks ot
    on 1=1
    and ot.task_name='TSK_EDS_CRM_ADDRESS'


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT TOP 1 @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CRM_ADDRESS]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT TOP 1 @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = dateadd(dd,-1,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE))  FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CRM_ADDRESS];
SELECT 	@PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
